messages.text:
Hello there, i made a mistake: I wanted to order the magic miner.

Could you please cancel the last order? I will then order the right one. Thx
Von meinem iPhone gesendet

Hello,

Thanks for writing. You don't need to cancel and order again. I can change the order you already placed to the Magic M. 40T, so it keeps the same order number. If the new price is different, I'll tell you the exact amount before anything changes.

I couldn't find the order from your message yet. Please reply with the order number from your confirmation email, for example Shop····. Please also send one detail from the order so I can match it: the name it ships to, the postcode ····email address you used.

As soon as I have those, I'll check that the order hasn't left our warehouse. Then I'll send you the price difference for the Magic M., and I'll make the change once you say yes. The Magic M. 40T is a pre-order. The factory plans to ship the units out on November 12, and you get the tracking by email as soon as yours ships to you.

Sarah

Thank you very much. Will order the other one as soon as I got the money back.

Have a great weekend :)
Von meinem iPhone gesendet

Hi David,

Thanks, and a great weekend to you too.

Just so nothing gets ordered twice: you don't need to place a new order. Your order Shop···· is already the Magic M. 40T, and the Harlo B30 has been taken off it. The $100 coming back to your PayPal is only the price difference between the two. Your Magic M. is fully paid and stays on this order.

If you meant a second miner on top of this one, that's fine, just order it as usual. Otherwise there's nothing else you need to do. Your tracking will come by email as soon as your Magic M. ships.

I was very happy to help. If you were pleased with our service, we'd really appreciate your feedback on Trustpilot: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com . You're also welcome to join our Discord for the latest products and help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Sarah

Wow you guys are quick! Thank you very much. That works for me.

Have great one.
